title: Gigantification
description: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.
smart_description: The next {Amount:plural:Attack you play deals|[blue]{}[/blue] Attacks you play deal} triple damage.
notes: Triggers on the next Attack card from the power's owner that is powered (not Ethereal). Applies a 3x multiplicative damage modifier. Each counter decrements by 1 after its triggering Attack resolves.
